title: Single equipment failure
initiating_event: One compressor train fails (wear-out failure between overhauls)
assumptions: Second train keeps running; production is choked back by the compression constraint; Repair duration and cost as in the base model (spares not pre-positioned)

title: Firewater system degradation
initiating_event: One electric firewater pump out of service for the year and the diesel pump in poor condition
assumptions: Only one electric pump available (architecture 1 instead of 2); Diesel pump fail-to-start probability three times the base value; No other change; the scenario is a degraded state, not an event

title: Major hydrocarbon release
initiating_event: Large gas release on Production Platform A
assumptions: Outcome follows the event tree (detection, isolation, ignition, fire protection); Escalation to WHP / PPB possible as in the base model

title: Multi-platform shutdown
initiating_event: Explosion on PPB that escalates to PPA and UCP
assumptions: Outcome fixed to 'explosion' on PPB with escalation to both PPA and UCP; UCP damage takes out main power, so all production stops (dependency model)

title: Extreme weather + equipment failure
initiating_event: Severe storm (10-day median shut-in) during which a compressor train fails
assumptions: Storm shut-in median 10 days instead of 3; Compressor failure on restart; repairs delayed by logistics (factor 1.5); Logistics factor also applies to all other repairs in the year

title: Common-cause power failure
initiating_event: Fuel-gas contamination trips all generators (common cause)
assumptions: Complex-wide blackout; restart takes a median of 5 days (contamination clean-up); During the blackout fire protection relies on the diesel pump (reported as PFD with power lost)

title: High commodity price + prolonged outage
initiating_event: Major fire on PPA in a year with oil at 110 USD/bbl
assumptions: Oil price fixed at 110 USD/bbl (about the 94th percentile of the price assumption); Outcome fixed to 'major_fire' on PPA; Logistics factor 1.5 (repair delayed)
